title: Bumblebee dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7c0' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff7c0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- motion sparkles -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='30' r='2.2' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='24' r='2' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='72' r='1.8' fill='#9be3ff'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='70' r='2.4' fill='#9be3ff'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#ffd0f0'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#ffd0f0'/>
  <!-- wings (behind body) -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='26' rx='14' ry='8' fill='#bfe8ff' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-28 38 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='26' rx='14' ry='8' fill='#bfe8ff' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(28 62 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='34' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#e6f7ff' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(-15 40 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='34' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#e6f7ff' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(15 60 34)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='22' ry='24' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M28.5 48 Q50 42 71.5 48 L70 55 Q50 49 30 55 Z' fill='#4a3a1a'/>
  <path d='M29.5 63 Q50 57 70.5 63 L68 71 Q50 65 32 71 Z' fill='#4a3a1a'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ffe98a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#4a3a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='27' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#5c4a24'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M44 19 Q40 8 33 6' stroke='#4a3a1a' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 19 Q60 8 67 6' stroke='#4a3a1a' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='5' r='3' fill='#ff9de0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='5' r='3' fill='#ff9de0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='29' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#0b0f1e'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='29' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#0b0f1e'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='27' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='27' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 35 Q50 39 55 35' stroke='#ff9de0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- dancing arms -->
  <path d='M29 50 Q18 44 15 32' stroke='#4a3a1a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M71 50 Q82 44 85 32' stroke='#4a3a1a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='30' r='4' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='30' r='4' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <path d='M42 79 Q38 88 32 92' stroke='#4a3a1a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 79 Q62 88 68 92' stroke='#4a3a1a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='93' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#4a3a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='93' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#4a3a1a'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M50 80 L50 88' stroke='#4a3a1a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
